name: run_pattern_file
title: Run Pattern Language Code
description: Evaluates ImHex Pattern Language code against the currently selected data source and returns the parsed structure as a JSON tree, along with any compile/eval errors, console output and 'out' variables. This is ImHex's core binary-parsing engine. Provide exactly one of 'source' (inline code) or 'path' (a .hexpat file, e.g. from suggest_patterns). Pattern includes (std library etc.) resolve automatically.

path.description: Path to a .hexpat pattern file to execute (alternative to source)

in_variables.description: Input variables (in <type> name) to pass into the pattern, as name -> value (number, boolean or string)

include_patterns.description: Whether to include the full parsed pattern tree in the result. Set false for large files when you only need out variables / errors

success.description: True if the pattern compiled and evaluated without errors

out_variables.description: Values of 'out' variables declared in the pattern

patterns.description: Parsed pattern tree as JSON (present when include_patterns is true and evaluation succeeded)
